name: The St. Regis Costa Mujeres Resort, Cancun
insider_take: This is where Cancun's legendary party scene meets sophisticated luxury - and somehow, it works perfectly.
whats_special: The St. Regis Costa Mujeres sits on a pristine stretch of white sand beach in an exclusive enclave just 20 minutes north of Cancun's hotel zone. This ultra-luxury resort features the brand's signature butler service, multiple infinity pools, and direct access to some of the Caribbean's most untouched coral reefs. The property is also home to Remède Spa and offers easy access to nearby Isla Mujeres via a quick ferry ride.
pro_tip: Book the signature St. Regis Suite for exclusive access to the rooftop terrace with panoramic views of both the Caribbean Sea and Nichupté Lagoon - it's one of the few spots where you can watch both sunrise and sunset from the same location.
dont_miss: The resort's cenote-inspired spa treatments using indigenous Mayan healing techniques, and definitely take the complimentary kayak tour through the nearby mangrove channels at sunset. The area is also a nesting ground for sea turtles from May to September - witnessing a hatching release is truly magical.
pros: Exclusive beachfront location in pristine Costa Mujeres with white sand beaches
Legendary St. Regis Butler Service providing personalized attention
Multiple world-class dining venues including celebrity chef restaurants
Luxurious overwater suites with direct lagoon access
Comprehensive wellness facilities including Remède Spa and state-of-the-art fitness center
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects ultra-high-end positioning
Located 30 minutes from Cancun's main tourist attractions
